licence.scope: ESO archive data policy (level 2), followed by analogy from ESO/ESO; no statement names these curves. SVO cites the ESO TIMMI2 page (https://www.eso.org/public/teles-instr/lasilla/36/timmi2/) and the old WFI filters page, which carry no terms (404/no text). Class attribution because the policy states CC BY 4.0 (sibling ESO/ESO is recorded unknown with the same quotes; align the two). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
